finding.mechanism: The billed-create confirmation bound only the deterministic campaign fingerprint. The live provider price estimate was not part of the confirmation value, so a later create preflight with the same corpus/model/hyperparameters but a changed price could reuse the old owner confirmation as long as the new estimate remained below the USD 18 hard cap.
finding.owner_contract_impact: Fresh explicit cost/run authorization was not cryptographically bound to the exact live preflight cost.

unusual_experiment.name: PRICE_DRIFT_AFTER_PREFLIGHT
unusual_experiment.intervention: Authorize the same campaign fingerprint at USD 4.00, then change only the live estimated price to USD 17.99.
unusual_experiment.notes: The legacy require_create_confirmation(fp) accepted the old fingerprint because price was not an input. This is a source/mechanism falsifier, not a real provider billing event.

changes: derive a SHA-256 authorization token from campaign_fingerprint plus canonical live estimated_usd
require the exact authorization only after the current live estimate and budget gate
persist authorized_estimated_usd and create_authorization in create-intent schema v3
fail closed on NaN, infinity, and negative price estimates
force fresh authorization whenever the live price changes

current_public_provider_refresh.pricing: Together public pricing currently lists standard Full SFT up to 16B at USD 0.54 per 1M processed tokens and a USD 4 standard minimum job charge.
current_public_provider_refresh.create_api: Current Together create-job docs expose suffix, model_output_name, training_type, random_seed, learning_rate and warmup_ratio on the fine-tuning contract.
current_public_provider_refresh.authority: Authenticated model_limits + server-side file validation + live estimate remain authoritative before any billed create.
